capabilities: Render a Gantt-style text-art timeline from a bullet list or fenced code block
Chain sibling tasks automatically so each starts where the previous ends
Schedule in calendar-days or workdays mode that skips weekends
Pin start dates and durations with {start, duration} syntax and color tasks
Flag overtime when subtasks run past a project's planned total
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the plain-list mode works only in Reading view.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render a schedule or Gantt-style timeline from plain Markdown bullet lists.
summary: Timeline renderer that turns a bullet list with duration estimates into a monospace text-art Gantt-style timeline.
